genius.licensingRegulator: OCC (conditional national trust bank charter, Feb 2026); FinCEN / state money transmitter regulators
genius.notes: Bridge received conditional OCC approval (Feb 12, 2026) to organize Bridge National Trust Bank, NA — an uninsured national trust bank, which maps to the 'federal-qualified-nonbank' PPSI pathway under the OCC's GENIUS Act NPRM. Bridge publicly states its compliance framework 'already positions Bridge to be GENIUS ready.' This is a trust-charter conditional approval under existing OCC authority, not a PPSI approval under the GENIUS Act (which remains in proposed-rules phase). No PPSI approvals exist as of 2026-06-18.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, or official GENIUS Act PPSI application has been publicly filed or approved for Bridge or USDsui. Bridge's OCC conditional charter approval is a trust-charter action under existing OCC authority, not a GENIUS Act PPSI authorization.
